name: Generate and email personalized PDFs from Google Sheets with PDF.co

parameters.content:
## Generate and email personalized PDFs from Google Sheets with PDF.co

### How it works
1. **When New Campaign Row Added** watches a Google Sheet. Each new row is one recipient.
2. **Create Personalized PDF** fills a saved PDF.co HTML template with that row's values.
3. **Insert Company Logo into PDF** stamps your logo into the space the template reserves for it.
4. **Fetch PDF File** downloads the finished PDF, and **Send PDF via Email** sends it from Gmail to the row's `customer_email`.

### Setup steps
1. Connect Google Sheets and select your spreadsheet and tab in **When New Campaign Row Added**.
2. Create the headers shown in **Sheet columns**, with one recipient per row.
3. Copy the HTML from **Sample HTML** on this canvas into a new [HTML template](https://app.pdf.co/html-templates-tool/manager) in your PDF.co account and save it, or use your own template.
4. Enter that saved template's ID in **Create Personalized PDF** and select the PDF.co credential for the account that owns it. Keep converter margins at **0**.
5. In **Insert Company Logo into PDF**, select the same credential and enter your logo under **Images**: a public HTTPS URL, or a file you [upload to PDF.co](https://app.pdf.co/tools/files). The position is already set for the sample HTML.
6. Connect Gmail in **Send PDF via Email**. For the first test, put an address you control in `customer_email` and check the attachment before activating.

### Customization
- Edit the sample HTML, or add Sheet columns and map them in **Template Data**.
- For a different layout, find new logo coordinates with [PDF Inspector](https://app.pdf.co/pdf-inspector).
- Change the email subject and message in **Send PDF via Email**.

**Note:** There is no duplicate-send tracking, so re-running a row sends the email again.

## 1. Watch campaign rows

Starts the workflow when a new row is added, polling every minute.

**Setup:** connect Google Sheets, then select your own spreadsheet and tab.

Add one complete row per recipient, using the exact headers in **Sheet columns**. They are already mapped to the PDF template and email.

## 2. Create the PDF

Copy the HTML from the **Sample HTML** note into a new template in [your PDF.co account](https://app.pdf.co/html-templates-tool/manager). Save the template, then enter its **HTML Template ID** in **Create Personalized PDF**.

**Template Data** already maps the Sheet values using `JSON.stringify()`.

Use the account that owns the saved template. Keep converter margins at **0**: the sample HTML supplies its own padding and reserves space for the logo.

## 3. Insert your logo

**Setup:** under **Images**, enter your own public HTTPS logo URL or [account-owned PDF.co](https://app.pdf.co/tools/files) `filetoken://` reference.

The logo is stamped into the reserved space on page **0**: X **36**, Y **32**, width **160**, height **40** PDF points.

Keep **Keep Aspect Ratio** enabled. For a different layout, find your own coordinates with [PDF Inspector](https://app.pdf.co/pdf-inspector).

## 4. Download and email

**Fetch PDF File** downloads the finished PDF into binary field **data**. **Send PDF via Email** attaches **data** and takes the recipient and message from the Sheet row.

**Setup:** connect Gmail. Check `customer_email` before running.

Errors stop the workflow. There is no duplicate-send tracking, so re-running a row sends another email.

## Sheet columns

Create these headers across row 1 of your Google Sheet, with one recipient per row:
```
customer_name | customer_email | campaign_title | campaign_subtitle
brand_color | hero_image | headline | body_text | cta_link | cta_text
footer_text | year | company_name
```

`customer_email` supplies the email recipient. The other columns supply the placeholders in **Sample HTML**, such as `{{customer_name}}`. Use `cta_link` and `cta_text` without spaces.

`hero_image` can be blank; the HTML omits that section. Use a six-digit hex value for `brand_color`, such as `#2459D3`, and a full HTTPS URL for `cta_link`. Provide the logo directly in the **Insert Company Logo into PDF** node.

nodes.name: When New Campaign Row Added
nodes.notes: Connect Google Sheets, select your spreadsheet and tab, and use Row Added. Create the columns listed in the Sheet columns note on the canvas. Enter complete rows.

nodes.name: Create Personalized PDF
nodes.notes: Copy the complete code from the Sample HTML note into a saved Handlebars template in your PDF.co account. Enter that template ID and select its account credential. Template Data is mapped from the Sheet. Keep margins at zero for this HTML, which supplies page padding and reserved logo space. Leave Webhook URL empty.

parameters.templateData:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  campaign_title: $json.campaign_title,
  campaign_subtitle: $json.campaign_subtitle,
  brand_color: $json.brand_color,
  hero_image: $json.hero_image,
  headline: $json.headline,
  body_text: $json.body_text,
  cta_link: $json.cta_link,
  cta_text: $json.cta_text,
  footer_text: $json.footer_text,
  year: $json.year,
  company_name: $json.company_name,
  customer_name: $json.customer_name
}) }}

nodes.name: Insert Company Logo into PDF
nodes.notes: Use the same PDF.co account as Create Personalized PDF. Under Images, enter your own public HTTPS logo URL or account-owned filetoken:// reference. The sample HTML reserves space on page 0 for X=36, Y=32, width=160, height=40 PDF points. Keep Aspect Ratio is enabled. For other coordinates, use PDF Inspector: https://app.pdf.co/pdf-inspector

advancedOptions.name: ={{ ($('When New Campaign Row Added').item.json.campaign_title + '-' + $('When New Campaign Row Added').item.json.customer_name).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\r\n]/g, '-') + '.pdf' }}

nodes.name: Fetch PDF File
nodes.notes: Download the logo-stamped PDF using its returned URL. Response Format is File and the output field is data. Do not add PDF.co credentials to this request.

nodes.name: Send PDF via Email
nodes.notes: Connect Gmail. To, Subject and Message use the linked Google Sheets row; the attachment field is data. This node sends to customer_email. Before testing, use an address you control in that Sheet column.
